description: This file implements the AcpxRuntime class, which manages runtime sessions, command execution, and status handling for the acpx backend in a plugin system. It includes methods for session creation, health checks, command execution, and event processing, utilizing internal utilities and external modules.

classes.name: AcpxRuntime
classes.description: Implements the AcpRuntime interface for managing acpx backend sessions, command execution, health checks, and event handling.

methods.name: isHealthy
methods.description: Returns the current health status of the runtime.

methods.name: probeAvailability
methods.description: Checks and updates the runtime's availability status.

methods.name: ensureSession
methods.description: Ensures a session exists with the specified parameters, creating or replacing as needed.

methods.name: runTurn
methods.description: Executes a runtime turn, spawning a process, handling input/output, and yielding events.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the capabilities of the runtime.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a session handle.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the mode for a session handle.

methods.name: setConfigOption
methods.description: Sets a configuration option for a session handle.

methods.name: doctor
methods.description: Performs a health check and returns a report.

methods.name: resolveHandleState
methods.description: Decodes a runtime handle into internal session state.

methods.name: buildPromptArgs
methods.description: Builds command-line arguments for prompt execution.

methods.name: buildVerbArgs
methods.description: Constructs command-line arguments with optional agent resolution.

methods.name: resolveRawAgentCommand
methods.description: Resolves the raw agent command, possibly using cache.

methods.name: runControlCommand
methods.description: Executes a control command and processes the result.
